python3 -c "
import json, sys, os
sys.stdin.read()
cwd_real = os.path.realpath(os.getcwd())
env_proj = os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR')
proj = env_proj if env_proj and os.path.realpath(env_proj) == cwd_real else cwd_real
MAX = 64 * 1024
mp = os.path.join(proj, '.claude/memory/MEMORY.md')
rp = os.path.join(proj, '.claude/memory/all_session_basic_rules.md')
def load(p, sig):
    try:
        with open(p, 'r') as f: c = f.read()
    except Exception: return None
    if len(c) > MAX: return None
    if sig not in c: return None
    return c
memory = load(mp, '<!-- BEGIN cc-baseline -->')
rules = load(rp, 'Core Rules for Every Session')
if memory is None or rules is None:
    print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'SessionStart', 'additionalContext': '⚠️ cc-baseline: project memory failed validation (missing cc-baseline marker, missing signature, or > 64KB) — context injection skipped. Re-run `npx --yes github:fffight88/cc-baseline --project --yes` to restore.'}}))
    sys.exit(0)
context = '# Project MEMORY.md\n' + memory + '\n\n# Project all_session_basic_rules.md\n' + rules
print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'SessionStart', 'additionalContext': context}}))
"

python3 -c "
import json, sys, os
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
file_path = data.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', '')
try:
    real_path = os.path.realpath(file_path) if file_path else ''
except Exception:
    real_path = ''
cwd_real = os.path.realpath(os.getcwd())
env_proj = os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR')
proj = env_proj if env_proj and os.path.realpath(env_proj) == cwd_real else cwd_real
protected = os.path.realpath(os.path.join(proj, '.claude', 'memory'))
if real_path == protected or real_path.startswith(protected + os.sep):
    print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'PreToolUse', 'permissionDecision': 'deny', 'permissionDecisionReason': 'cc-baseline path protection: ./.claude/memory/ is managed by cc-baseline only. Save auto-memory elsewhere.'}}))
    sys.exit(2)
"
